verdict.rationale: Bias reduction is a fair question for an applicant tracking system, but the evidence pack shows no structured feedback ordering, no demographic-blind or anonymized review option, and no DEI/EEO funnel reporting. The candidate rating endpoint and the generic custom report builder are adjacent features, not bias-reduction capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel
